criteria_verification.criterion_text: `study-tutor serve-nats --nats nats://localhost:4222` starts the adapter, blocks until SIGTERM, then shuts down cleanly.
criteria_verification.evidence: _serve_adapter() awaits adapter.start(), installs SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers via loop.add_signal_handler() (with NotImplementedError fallback for Windows), awaits a shared shutdown_event.wait(), and on completion runs adapter.stop() in a finally block followed by runtime_shutdown(write_helper). The CLI body wires --nats into config.nats.url before calling _build_nats_runtime() and runs the lifecycle via asyncio.run(_serve_adapter(...)). Verified by test_serve_adapter_starts_then_stops_when_shutdown_event_is_set (asserts start.assert_awaited_once + stop.assert_awaited_once when the event is set) and test_serve_adapter_registers_sigterm_and_sigint_handlers (asserts both signal.SIGTERM and signal.SIGINT are passed to add_signal_handler).

criteria_verification.criterion_text: SIGTERM during a running tutor process triggers `adapter.stop()` and the process exits with code 0 within the drain window (30s).
criteria_verification.evidence: Signal handlers registered for SIGINT and SIGTERM both call _request_shutdown(), which sets shutdown_event. The wait()→finally branch then awaits adapter.stop() (NATSAdapter owns the 30s drain timeout per TASK-NATS-PH1-005 scope) before runtime_shutdown(). On the happy path (no exception during start), no SystemExit is raised so click reports exit code 0. test_serve_adapter_registers_sigterm_and_sigint_handlers regression-guards the SIGTERM/SIGINT registration and test_serve_adapter_starts_then_stops_when_shutdown_event_is_set covers the start→stop sequencing.

criteria_verification.criterion_text: If `nats-core`'s `AgentConfig` validation fails (e.g. invalid `NATS_URL`), the CLI exits 1 with a clear error message.
criteria_verification.evidence: _load_agent_config() wraps any AgentConfig() construction failure in a typed _AgentConfigValidationError. The serve_nats body catches that exception, emits '[study-tutor] Error: AgentConfig validation failed: {exc.cause}' to stderr (preserving the underlying pydantic field names), and raises SystemExit(1). _serve_adapter additionally exits 1 when adapter.start() raises (with a separate banner and a best-effort stop()). Verified by test_serve_nats_exits_1_when_agent_config_validation_fails (asserts exit code 1, banner present, and underlying field name AGENT_MODELS__REASONING_MODEL flows through into stderr) and test_serve_adapter_exits_1_when_start_raises.
